svg.title: Enterprise-Grade ACL Authorization (Keycloak + .NET Enforcement + SQL Server) — End-to-End View

g.text: Enterprise-Grade ACL Authorization (Keycloak + .NET Enforcement + SQL Server) — End-to-End View
Never embed object-level ACL in JWT:
Explicit semantics per action risk (reads vs writes).
Treat permission vocabulary as an API contract:
- No ACL in JWT (avoid bloat + revocation bugs)
- Batch auth for list endpoints (TVPs, set-based)
- Governance: permission vocabulary as a contract
